value.title: Grounding-critic module (fail-closed core)
value.description: Create the fail-closed grounding critic as a standalone, pure, injectable module — the risk-first crux of the feature (the fail-open -> fail-closed inversion of the fleet critic). New file src/medical/retrieval/grounding-critic.ts exports: a GroundingVerdict type {verdict:'approve'|'reject'; feedback:string} (mirrors src/fleet/critic-deep.ts:54-59 CritiqueVerdict); a zod GroundingVerdictSchema; validateGroundingVerdict(rawText) that NEVER throws (direct JSON.parse -> markdown-fence extraction -> first-brace slice -> safeParse, returning {ok,verdict}|{ok:false,error} — copy the tolerant shape from critic-deep.ts:67-115); a buildGroundingSystemPrompt(question, answerBody, passages) that pins the critic to the cited passages and instructs a faithfulness+completeness review; an internal callGroundingCritic that sends a FRESH message array (NEVER extends a prior conversation — mirror critic-deep.ts:130 LOCK1) with jsonObjectMode:true; and getGroundingVerdict({ llm, model, question, answerBody, passages }) that runs a bounded retry-with-coercion loop (1 + GROUNDING_PARSE_MAX_RETRIES attempts) and, on parse exhaustion, FAIL-CLOSED returns {verdict:'reject', feedback:'<unparseable critic output>'} — the exact inversion of critic-deep.ts:199-201 which returns approve. Export GROUNDING_PARSE_MAX_RETRIES and a GROUNDING_MAX_LLM_CALLS budget constant. This sprint adds NO engine wiring and NO config — the app builds and all existing tests pass unchanged.

successCriteria.description: The project builds with zero TypeScript errors (npm run build) and zero typecheck errors in strict mode (npm run typecheck).
The full test suite passes with zero failures including new collocated src/medical/retrieval/grounding-critic.test.ts (npm run test); no regression in the pre-existing suite.

validateGroundingVerdict(rawText) NEVER throws for any string input — proven by a parametrized test over raw JSON, fenced JSON, JSON-with-prose, empty string, and pure garbage — returning {ok:true,verdict} for valid shapes and {ok:false,error} otherwise.

getGroundingVerdict returns {verdict:'approve'} ONLY when the model explicitly emits an approve verdict; when a fake LLMClient returns unparseable text on every attempt, it returns verdict==='reject' (FAIL-CLOSED), asserted directly against the returned object.

The critic call uses a fresh message array built from (question, answer body, cited passages) and passes jsonObjectMode-style structured prompting; a test inspecting the fake client's received messages asserts the array starts with a single user turn containing the passages and does NOT include any prior synthesis assistant turn.
getGroundingVerdict makes at most GROUNDING_MAX_LLM_CALLS LLM calls (= 1 + GROUNDING_PARSE_MAX_RETRIES); a call-counting fake asserts the cap is honored on the parse-exhaustion path.

grounding-critic.ts adds NO @anthropic-ai/sdk, openai, node:net, node:http, or fetch import (depends only on zod and the injected LLMClient type from providers/types.ts); the scoped medical ESLint boundary still passes (npm run lint).

nonGoals: Do not wire the critic into MedicalSopEngine.run or src/medical/retrieval/literature.ts (Sprint 2).
Do not add any config.medical model/provider fields or touch EgressGuard (Sprint 3).
Do not add the criticVerdict audit field yet (Sprint 3).
Do not perform any re-synthesis here — getGroundingVerdict only judges; the loop lands in Sprint 2.
Do not import or call any real network/cloud client; the module is pure given an injected LLMClient.
stopConditions: getGroundingVerdict is fail-closed (reject on exhaustion), validateGroundingVerdict never throws, the call budget is capped, and build/typecheck/test/lint are green with no regression

Collocated grounding-critic.test.ts covers: never-throws validation across input shapes; approve only on explicit approve; fail-closed reject on parse exhaustion; fresh-message-array construction; call-budget cap. No engine/config/audit changes. Build, typecheck, test, and lint pass with no regression.

value.title: Gated synthesis flow + engine wiring
value.description: Compose the grounding critic with synthesis into a fail-closed gate, and wire it into the engine's grounded-synthesis branch. Add synthesizeGrounded (new export in src/medical/retrieval/literature.ts, or a sibling grounded-gate.ts) that: (1) runs synthesize (literature.ts:98) to get the candidate MedicalAnswer; (2) if the candidate is already abstained/short-circuit, returns it unchanged; (3) otherwise runs getGroundingVerdict on the candidate body + its passages; (4) on approve -> return the candidate; (5) on reject -> re-run synthesize ONCE more, appending the critic feedback to the synthesis system prompt, then re-critique; (6) on second approve -> return the re-synthesized answer; on second reject OR any thrown transport/model error at any step -> return an ABSTAINED MedicalAnswer (abstained:true, citations:[], footer present, body = the canned 'cannot ground a sufficiently-supported answer' message). The whole flow is wrapped so a thrown error from synthesize or the critic maps to abstain (fail-closed). Replace the single synthesize call at src/medical/engine.ts:402-403 with synthesizeGrounded, threading the same llmClient, footer, and the grounded RetrievalOutcome. Preserve EVERY existing zero-LLM negative assertion: consent-refuse, red-flag short-circuit, content-policy refuse, numeric-only, and literature-disabled paths must construct NO grounding critic and make NO critic LLM call. Bound the grounded-path LLM calls by a named constant GROUNDED_GATE_MAX_LLM_CALLS (synthesize + critic + at most one re-synth + one re-critique).

successCriteria.description: The project builds with zero TypeScript errors (npm run build) and zero typecheck errors in strict mode (npm run typecheck).
The full test suite passes with zero failures including new collocated tests for synthesizeGrounded and updated src/medical/engine.test.ts (npm run test); no regression in the pre-existing suite.
When the critic approves the first synthesis, synthesizeGrounded returns the original grounded MedicalAnswer unchanged with its >=1 citations intact (asserted on a fake whose critic approves).

When the critic rejects then approves the re-synthesis, the RE-synthesized grounded answer is returned (distinct body, still >=1 citation); when it rejects BOTH, the result is abstained:true with citations:[] and the disclaimer footer present.

Any thrown error from synthesize or the critic (transport/model-unavailable) results in an abstained MedicalAnswer (abstained:true, citations:[]), never a propagated exception and never an ungrounded answer — asserted with fakes that throw at each step.

On the consent-refuse, red-flag short-circuit, content-policy refuse, numeric-only (sampleCount>0), and literature-disabled paths, MedicalSopEngine.run makes ZERO grounding-critic LLM calls — asserted with an injected spy LLMClient that fails if called, exactly as the existing red-flag spy assertion (engine.ts:53-56). Existing engine.test.ts zero-LLM assertions still pass.
The grounded path issues at most GROUNDED_GATE_MAX_LLM_CALLS LLM calls; a call-counting fake on a reject->reject scenario asserts the cap (synthesize + critic + re-synth + re-critique).

No new SDK/network import is added under src/medical; the scoped medical ESLint boundary passes (npm run lint). synthesizeGrounded depends only on the injected LLMClient and the Sprint-1 grounding-critic module.

nonGoals: Do not add config.medical model/provider fields or EgressGuard cloud gating (Sprint 3).
Do not add the AuditEntry.criticVerdict field or change audit calls (Sprint 3) — the engine still appends the existing answer/abstain event this sprint.
Do not change the MedicalSopEngine.run signature, the zero-arg constructor, or any upstream gate (consent/red-flag/refuse/numerics/factstore/egress).
Do not add more than ONE re-synthesis round.
Do not introduce a cloud client — keep using the existing local default client constructed at engine.ts:402.
stopConditions: The grounded branch is gated by the fail-closed critic with a single bounded re-synthesis, every non-grounded path remains zero-LLM, and build/typecheck/test/lint are green with no regression

All existing engine negative assertions (zero LLM on consent/red-flag/refuse/numeric/disabled) still hold. Collocated tests cover approve, reject->approve, reject->reject->abstain, throw->abstain, the call cap, and the zero-LLM non-grounded paths. Build, typecheck, test, lint pass with no regression.

The grounded RetrievalOutcome carries outcome.passages (RetrievalOutcome 'grounded' variant); synthesizeGrounded forwards those passages to getGroundingVerdict.

The engine still appends event:'answer' or 'abstain' (engine.ts:417) based on the returned MedicalAnswer.abstained; the criticVerdict audit field is deferred to Sprint 3.

value.title: Configurable model + cloud-inference egress gating + audit verdict
value.description: Make the synthesis/critic model+provider configurable and record the critic outcome in the audit log, while keeping cloud egress strictly behind the existing cloud-inference axis. (1) Extend MedicalSectionSchema (src/config/schema.ts:374-385) with an optional `inference` block: { provider?: string; endpoint?: string; model?: string } (zod, all optional). (2) Add a resolver buildMedicalInferenceClient(config, egress) in a small module (e.g. src/medical/inference.ts) that returns { client: LLMClient; model: string }: when config.medical.inference specifies a CLOUD provider (anything other than the local openai-compat localhost / ollama default), it is used ONLY if egress.isAllowed('cloud-inference') (src/medical/egress.ts:35) is true; otherwise the resolver FAILS CLOSED — it falls back to the local default (openai-compat http://localhost:11434/v1, llama3) so no cloud egress occurs. Absent any inference config, it returns the current local default unchanged (back-compat). (3) Wire engine.ts grounded branch to obtain its LLMClient+model from buildMedicalInferenceClient(config, egress) instead of the hardcoded createClient at engine.ts:402, passing the resolved model through synthesizeGrounded to the critic. (4) Extend AuditEntry (src/medical/types.ts:77-87) with optional `criticVerdict?: 'approve' | 'reject-abstained' | 'error-abstained'` (IDs/enums only) and append it on the grounded path: approve when the gate returned an approved answer, reject-abstained when the gate abstained after a critic reject, error-abstained when it abstained due to a thrown error. No prompt text or health values; AuditLog 0600 mode preserved.

successCriteria.description: The project builds with zero TypeScript errors (npm run build) and zero typecheck errors in strict mode (npm run typecheck).
The full test suite passes with zero failures including new collocated src/medical/inference.test.ts and updated engine/audit tests (npm run test); no regression in the pre-existing suite.

Given config.medical.inference specifying a cloud provider but medical.egress.cloudInference=false (default), buildMedicalInferenceClient returns the LOCAL default client (no cloud) — asserted by inspecting the resolved provider/endpoint and by a spy that fails if a cloud client is constructed/called.

Given config.medical.inference specifying a cloud provider AND medical.egress.cloudInference=true, buildMedicalInferenceClient returns a client/model built from that cloud config (proving the 'any model' capability is reachable behind the opt-in) — asserted via the resolved provider/model and an injected factory spy.

With NO config.medical.inference set, buildMedicalInferenceClient returns the exact current local default (openai-compat http://localhost:11434/v1, model llama3); a back-compat test asserts the grounded path behaves identically to Sprint 2.

After a grounded turn, the audit-<date>.jsonl entry carries exactly one criticVerdict value in {approve, reject-abstained, error-abstained} matching the gate outcome, alongside the existing event:'answer'|'abstain'; the line contains NO substring of the prompt or answer body and NO health value.
The audit file remains mode 0600 after appending the criticVerdict (stat assertion), and AuditEntry stays IDs/enums-only — criticVerdict is one of the three enum literals, never free text.

Zero outbound egress unless cloud-inference is enabled: with cloudInference=false and a network spy that throws on use, the grounded turn completes without invoking it; the scoped medical ESLint boundary still passes (npm run lint) and no new disallowed network import is added outside the providers factory seam.

nonGoals: Do not add a new egress axis — reuse cloud-inference (src/medical/egress.ts:5,35).
Do not change synthesizeGrounded's gate logic or the one-re-synthesis bound (Sprint 2).
Do not add cloud fallback chains, streaming, or caching.
Do not log prompt text, answer body, citations, or any health value into the audit entry — criticVerdict is an enum only.
Do not change the MedicalSopEngine.run signature or the zero-arg constructor; resolver is built from the config already passed to run().
stopConditions: Synthesis/critic model is configurable with cloud strictly gated by cloud-inference (fail-closed to local), back-compat is byte-identical with no config, the criticVerdict enum is audited IDs/enums-only at 0600, and build/typecheck/test/lint are green with no regression
value.definitionOfDone: src/config/schema.ts MedicalSectionSchema gains an optional inference:{provider?,endpoint?,model?} block. src/medical/inference.ts exports buildMedicalInferenceClient(config, egress):{client,model} — cloud only when cloudInference=true else fail-closed local default; identical local default when unset. src/medical/engine.ts grounded branch resolves its client+model via buildMedicalInferenceClient and threads the model into synthesizeGrounded. src/medical/types.ts AuditEntry gains optional criticVerdict enum; engine appends it on the grounded path. Collocated tests cover cloud-gated-off (local fallback), cloud-gated-on (cloud used), no-config back-compat, audit verdict value + PHI-free + 0600, and zero-egress-when-disabled. Build, typecheck, test, lint pass with no regression.
assumptions: EgressGuard already exposes isAllowed('cloud-inference') and is built from config via EgressGuard.fromConfig(config) (src/medical/egress.ts:25-48); the engine builds it at engine.ts:384 and can pass it to the resolver.

The providers factory createClient(provider, endpoint, apiKey?, model?) (src/providers/factory.ts, used at engine.ts:402) is the single client-construction seam; buildMedicalInferenceClient uses it and is the only place that decides local-vs-cloud.
'Local default' = provider 'openai-compat', endpoint 'http://localhost:11434/v1', model 'llama3' (engine.ts:402) — treated as non-egressing; any other provider/endpoint is treated as cloud and gated.
AuditEntry criticVerdict is optional and additive; existing entries without it remain valid (the field is only populated on the grounded answer/abstain path).

The criticVerdict value is derived from the gate result the engine already has: approved answer -> 'approve'; abstained-after-reject -> 'reject-abstained'; abstained-after-throw -> 'error-abstained'. Sprint 2's synthesizeGrounded must surface enough signal (return the verdict alongside the answer, or an enum) for the engine to classify — extend its return type if needed without changing its gate behavior.
outOfScope: Any change to upstream gates or numerics

src/medical/inference.ts (new): export function buildMedicalInferenceClient(config: BoberConfig, egress: EgressGuard): { client: LLMClient; model: string }. Logic: const inf = config.medical?.inference; const LOCAL = { provider:'openai-compat', endpoint:'http://localhost:11434/v1', model:'llama3' }; const wantProvider = inf?.provider ?? LOCAL.provider; const isLocal = wantProvider === 'openai-compat' && (inf?.endpoint ?? LOCAL.endpoint).includes('localhost'); if (!isLocal && !egress.isAllowed('cloud-inference')) { /* FAIL-CLOSED */ return { client: createClient(LOCAL.provider, LOCAL.endpoint, undefined, LOCAL.model), model: LOCAL.model }; } const provider = inf?.provider ?? LOCAL.provider; const endpoint = inf?.endpoint ?? LOCAL.endpoint; const model = inf?.model ?? LOCAL.model; return { client: createClient(provider, endpoint, undefined, model), model }; Add a tiny seam (e.g. an optional injected factory param defaulting to createClient) so tests can spy without real network. Unicode section headers; import type for LLMClient/BoberConfig/EgressGuard.

Thread synthModel into synthesizeGrounded so the critic uses the same model. At the audit append (:417) add criticVerdict derived from the gate outcome — extend synthesizeGrounded (Sprint 2) to return e.g. { answer, verdict: 'approve'|'reject-abstained'|'error-abstained' } and pass verdict into auditLog.append alongside event.
